arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom
from glom import glom, T, S, Spec, Call, Coalesce, Check, Path, Literal, Inspect
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke
from glom import Assign, assign

print('=== R2: Public API ===')
# Check all names exist
for name in ['Auto', 'Fill', 'Iter', 'Let', 'ROOT', 'Invoke']:
    assert hasattr(glom, name), f'{name} not found in glom'
    print(f'  {name}: OK')

# Check ROOT is a sentinel
print(f'  ROOT value: {ROOT}')

print()
print('=== R3: Invoke and constants ===')
print(f'  Invoke class: {Invoke}')
from glom import constants
print(f'  constants.SKIP: {constants.SKIP}')
print(f'  constants.STOP: {constants.STOP}')
print(f'  constants.OMIT: {constants.OMIT}')
print(f'  constants.ROOT: {constants.ROOT}')

print()
print('=== R4: Fill repr ===')
f = Fill('missing', 'default')
print(f'  Fill repr: {repr(f)}')

print()
print('=== R5: Assign repr ===')
a = Assign('a.b', 'value')
print(f'  Assign repr: {repr(a)}')
af = assign('x.y', 123)
print(f'  assign repr: {repr(af)}')

print()
print('=== R6: Coalesce repr ===')
c = Coalesce('a', 'b')
print(f'  Coalesce repr: {repr(c)}')

print()
print('=== R7: Other specifiers repr ===')
auto = Auto()
print(f'  Auto repr: {repr(auto)}')
check = Check(type(int))
print(f'  Check repr: {repr(check)}')

print()
print('=== Testing functionality ===')
target = {'a': 1, 'b': 2, 'name': 'hello'}

# Auto
print(f'  Auto(): {glom(target, Auto())}')

# Fill
print(f'  Fill missing: {glom(target, Fill(\"missing\", \"default\"))}')

# Iter
list_target = ['hello', 'world']
print(f'  Iter upper: {glom(list_target, Iter(Call(str.upper, (T,))))}')

# Let
print(f'  Let: {glom(target, Let({\"x\": \"a\"}, T[\"x\"]))}')

# ROOT
print(f'  ROOT: {glom(target, {\"root\": ROOT})}')

# Invoke
print(f'  Invoke: {glom(target, Invoke(str.upper, \"name\"))}')

# Assign
assign_target = {'a': {}}
glom(assign_target, Assign('a.b', 'value'))
print(f'  After assign: {assign_target}')

print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
